provenance.title: From Lead to Helium: Discovery Potential for Jet Quenching in the Smallest Collision Systems
provenance.authors: Coleridge Faraday,1, ∗Ben Bert,1, † Jack Brand,1, ‡ Werner Vogelsang,2, § and W. A. Horowitz1, 3, ¶

candidates.statement: While both 6Li and 10B are small nuclei, and so should in principle be modeled similarly to He or Ne / O, in this first work we model them with a Woods-Saxon distribution as only the one- and two-nucleon distributions from these more sophisti- cated nucleon configurations are available.
